source.current_blob_definition: Blob at the immutable verified source checkpoint; not the mutable working tree.
source.ancestry_note: Import is a root snapshot with the exact upstream tree; it does not invent upstream commit ancestry.

exclusions: unchanged upstream paths from per-path diff inventory
scope.unknown_semantics: Per-path blob identity establishes content lineage only. Semantic equivalence and impact of future upstream changes require review and behavioral gates.
scope.coverage_note: Boundary symbol mappings are selected source-grounded anchors, not a complete symbol graph or claim of complete native extraction.

ownership.state: Selected native process owns writers, fork leases, native rollout/state resources and maintenance; host auxiliary SQLite remains separate.
ownership.dependencies: ThreadStore contract, trusted state codec, persistent process runtime, rollout/state and native paths.
ownership.lifecycle: Selection before native construction; accepted writes supervised; explicit whole-store shutdown and owned maintenance joins; forced termination reports uncertainty.

gaps: Auxiliary host SQLite services and manual migration remain separate.
Cross-platform and complete workspace regression coverage are not established.

ownership.state: Native inline implementation is stateless; adapter owns private staged input for invocation lifetime.
ownership.dependencies: Attachment API, component transport, private blob staging, engine selection adapter.
ownership.lifecycle: Fresh process per call, bounded payload staging and cleanup; selection preserves explicit injection/isolated defaults.

gaps: Upload is the production caller; resolve has adapter-level evidence.
Remote blob retention, deletion and migration are not extracted.

ownership.state: Host owns prompt/turn/policy; one invocation owns inference stream and its backend credentials.
ownership.dependencies: Native normalized request and response events, component runtime, native request contributors/interceptors.
ownership.lifecycle: Invocation per stream; terminal frame validation and process cleanup; cancellation drops invocation; no native backend fallback.

gaps: Native HTTP/WebSocket transport is not a separate package.
Version 1 has a 4 MiB physical frame limit and generic terminal error mapping.
Catalog, provider routing, realtime and unary summaries remain separate.

ownership.state: Component owns acquisition/refresh across calls; native AuthManager validates policy and commits credentials.
ownership.dependencies: ExternalAuth interface, component transport, native restrictions and account ownership.
ownership.lifecycle: Selection at AuthManager startup; fresh resolve/refresh invocation; redacted errors; workload identity cannot be replaced.

gaps: Native OAuth, keyring, login UI, account management and durable credential stores are not extracted.

ownership.state: GUI owns client presentation; gateway owns App Server connection/process; engine/storage own sessions and persistence.
ownership.dependencies: App Server JSON-RPC, component manager lifecycle, browser assets, actual Codex executable.
ownership.lifecycle: Ready service until shutdown; manager Ctrl+C allows gateway/App Server/storage cleanup; forced exit reports uncertainty.

gaps: This is a new GUI, not extracted official desktop UI or TUI/App Server internals.
In-app Browser/remote-viewer reachability was not proven by recovered cloud browser evidence.

ownership.state: Host catalog snapshots and immutable package bindings; component-specific state directories.
ownership.dependencies: Manifest/version validation, discovery/install/remove, process transports and native extension registration.
ownership.lifecycle: Per-call or explicit persistent sessions; existing bindings survive replacement/removal; no live swap.

gaps: Tools/context/lifecycle contributors do not extract their native managers.
Reverse dependency broker is staged and unlinked.

ownership.state: Proposed worker owns native merge/cache; host owns owner-fenced mirror and credential/network authority.
ownership.dependencies: Unlinked broker grant host.model_endpoint, manager activation patch and async core composition.
ownership.lifecycle: Proposed retained accepted cache work, owner validation, admission revocation and explicit process close.

gaps: No active catalog component exists; sources and tests are not execution evidence.
Workspace/host/SDK activation, ownership epoch, core provenance and health plumbing remain incomplete.

update_rule: Every extraction and upstream integration must add or revise path/symbol/ownership/contract/evidence mappings, enumerate the complete checkpoint diff, preserve previous lineage snapshots, and leave unknown semantics explicit.
